about_the_game:
Kuromaku Demo – Prologue

Kuromaku Demo is a slow-burn psychological horror experience set in the intimate, unsettling confines of your father’s apartment. After your parents’ divorce, you move in with him, beginning what feels like an ordinary day marked by small household tasks. Yet as you settle in, the atmosphere begins to shift—ordinary moments unravel into something darker, hinting that not everything is as it seems.

Gameplay & Atmosphere

  • Carry boxes. Unpack. Share breakfast. Clean the bathroom. Restock the kitchen.

  • These simple, everyday moments gradually twist into disquieting experiences: a door that won’t stay closed, a delivery man whose face feels wrong, the creeping sense of being watched.

Key Features

  • Narrative-Driven Horror – A prequel chapter that sets the tone for the full game.

  • Everyday Tasks with Uneasy Twists – Familiar routines turn into unsettling encounters.

  • Psychological Tension – A lingering dread designed to unsettle long after you step away.

This demo offers just a glimpse of what’s to come. The full game will expand the story and immerse you deeper into its disturbing world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 3GB / AMD RX 580 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Designed for gameplay at 1080p, High settings
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for 1080p/1440p, High–Epic settings
